rationale: Directly automates license identification from raw text (not just filename/SPDX-tag matching), the core capability RQ2 asks for to prevent training on unlicensed data at scale.
SPDX's own reference implementation of automated license-text matching -- same capability RQ2 asks for, independently maintained from licenseid, both legitimately useful.

Aggregates metadata (including license) from multiple sources per model and explicitly surfaces disagreements as field-level {value, source, conflict} triplets -- directly the accuracy-when-aggregating-multiple-sources mechanism RQ3 asks about, applied to AI model metadata rather than datasets specifically.
Outputs a provenance-tracked BOM (SPDX 3.0.1 JSON-LD, CycloneDX 1.6 ML-BOM) suitable for verifying that an audited model's declared composition matches its actual, reconciled multi-source metadata.

Generates a CycloneDX ML-BOM from actual repository scanning of Hugging Face model usage, giving an auditor a verifiable record of which model(s) a codebase actually uses to check against what was declared.

Turns a machine-readable ML-BOM into a human-reviewable document -- the presentation layer that makes model-version/composition verification actually practical for an auditor, not just theoretically possible from raw JSON.

The foundational format specification (including the AI/ML-BOM profile) that gives model-version/component declarations a verifiable, tool-interoperable structure -- the standard several already-catalogued tools (kitops, sbom-tools, k8s-aibom, and this batch's aikaboom/aibomgen-cli/mlbomdoc) implement against, same relationship model-signing-spec already has to this RQ.

Extracts Hugging Face model metadata into a CycloneDX 1.6 AIBOM with a completeness score -- gives an auditor a verifiable, standards-aligned record of a model's declared composition to check against what's actually deployed.
Extracts model-format-aware metadata (GGUF/ONNX/PyTorch/Hugging Face) directly into an SBOM, giving an auditor a verifiable record of a model's actual composition to check against what was declared.
